text: We measure the critical temperature $T_{c}$ of the film and find $T_{c}=9.2$ K. The supercurrent is carried by Andreev bound states; the gap closes at the transition. The ﬁeld dependence follows $\mathrm{d}I/\mathrm{d}V \propto \left(1-B/B_{c}\right)^{2}$ up to 1.5 T.
